reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "New CRD `managedresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.crossplane.io` (ManagedResourceDefinition, v1alpha1)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: If CRDs are managed separately from the release, the ManagedResourceDefinition CRD must be installed before upgrading; without it, the new resource type will not be available.

proposed.statement: A new CRD for ManagedResourceDefinition (managedresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1alpha1) was added and must be installed before upgrading if CRDs are managed separately from the release.
